title: [Dash] Bolus registred under treatments but not delivered
symptom: A bolus of 2.80u was registered in treatments and Nightscout but not delivered to the pump, causing unexpected bg rise.
cause: The bolus was entered via the 'Treatments' button with the 'Do not bolus, record only' option checked, so it was recorded but not sent to the pump.
fix: No fix needed; it was user error. The thread suggests watching for the 'delivery' dialogue after issuing a bolus to avoid this in the future.
